purpose: Require an explicit versioned adequacy review of exact real-photo same-subject pose/expression stability evidence before it can satisfy Face Space normalization readiness.
rules: Structural coverage of head_yaw, head_pitch, head_roll, and expression is necessary but not sufficient for readiness.
Adequacy must be bound to the exact stability-collection fingerprint and source run-manifest digests.
Measurement drift, nuisance coverage, subject-linkage provenance, and capture limitations must be explicitly reviewed.
No numeric stability threshold is invented by this contract.
Automatic adequacy inference from report count or nuisance-class coverage is forbidden.
Adequacy grants provisional research gating only and no Production normalization authority.
The adequacy decision must be bound to a descriptive review packet generated from the exact stability collection.
The review packet must carry observed drift and provenance without thresholds, automatic pass/fail, or ranking.
